content.value: A study shows that some companies violate federal population regulations with regard to 14 dumping a particular product. 20 firms are under suspicion but all can't be inspected. Suppose, 3 of the firms are in violation.
i) What is the probability that inspection of 5 firms find no violation?
ii) What is the probability that the plan above will find 2 violations?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
